title: Propagation of augmented polynomial coordinates to finite truncations
statement: Let $B,C$ be commutative rings, $C$ a formally smooth $B$-algebra, meaning that every $B$-algebra homomorphism $C\to D/K$ for a commutative $B$-algebra $D$ and nilpotent ideal $K$ lifts to $C\to D$, and $\varepsilon:C\to B$ a $B$-algebra augmentation. Put $I=\ker\varepsilon$. Fix $n\in\mathbb N$ and a $B$-algebra map $f:B[X_1,\ldots,X_n]\to C$, and put $J=(X_1,\ldots,X_n)$. Suppose $f(J)\subseteq I$ and $B[X_1,\ldots,X_n]/J^2\to C/I^2$ induced by $f$ is bijective. Then for every $k\in\mathbb N$, the induced map $B[X_1,\ldots,X_n]/J^k\to C/I^k$ is bijective. There is no locality or Noetherian assumption.

proof.text: Apply the separately stated surjectivity and injectivity induction components at each k and combine them into bijectivity.

lean.statement:
theorem bijective_augmented_polynomial_truncations
    (B C : Type u) [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [Algebra B C]
    [FormallySmooth B C] (ε : C →ₐ[B] B) (n : ℕ)
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) B →ₐ[B] C)
    (hf : MvPolynomial.idealOfVars (Fin n) B ≤
      (RingHom.ker ε.toRingHom).comap f.toRingHom)
    (h₂ : Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ((RingHom.ker ε.toRingHom) ^ 2) f
        ((pow_le_pow_left' hf 2).trans (Ideal.le_comap_pow f.toRingHom 2)))) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ((RingHom.ker ε.toRingHom) ^ k) f
        ((pow_le_pow_left' hf k).trans (Ideal.le_comap_pow f.toRingHom k)))
